row_convention: zero-based original M2 stored row; all row identities preserved in M2.csv.gz
selection_algorithm: Sort all models by initial_mae_z ascending, with original model_row ascending for ties. Choose ranks numpy.rint(target_percentile * (n_models-1)). Verify strict increase of MAE, KL and Brier and four distinct correctness vectors.
metric_weights: 1/N for each of the 5000 fixed sampled questions; independent of future querying policy
scope: Model selection only; no sequential experiments run and no simulation code changes.
